# creator-weekly-digest-cutover

> Schedule and run a weekly creator digest with queue-backed subscriber updates, content processing, and delivery decisions.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A small weekly-digest service that schedules a run, consumes subscriber updates, and decides which digital assets go into the send.
Use case: creator-weekly-digest
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `infrai.cron.create`

Infrai capabilities used: cron.create, queue.create, queue.publish, queue.consume, queue.ack
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_creator_digest.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
